_A_UTILITIES_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION_: The two-colored focus ring of the components for own focusable elements, e.g. a card with tabindex="0". It is shown for keyboard focus only and is configured with the focus tokens.
_A_UTILITIES_ORDER_DESCRIPTION_: Classes set the order of flex and grid items: a_order_first (−1), a_order_0 … a_order_5, a_order_last (6). Suffixes _mobile … _large enable them at breakpoints.
_A_UTILITIES_PRINT_DESCRIPTION_: a_print_none hides an element when printing, a_print_block shows it only in print (together with a_d_none).
_A_UTILITIES_TEXT_DESCRIPTION_: Secondary and emphasized text that stays readable in the light and the dark theme.
_A_UTILITIES_Z_INDEX_DESCRIPTION_: Global layers use the --a_z_index_* tokens, so own overlays stay in the right order with modals, dropdowns and popups.
